title: Entrance Fee Agreement Amortization of a Month Left Open at Termination
content:
**Rule.** For an **Entrance Fee Agreement**, a month of occupancy that began on or before the termination date and carries no amortization entry when the agreement terminates is amortized after the termination, once, whatever status the agreement has reached; every other amortization is booked only while the agreement is occupied, each month once.

A month of occupancy begins on the occupancy date or on a monthly anniversary of it, and the months are numbered from 1 for the month beginning on the occupancy date. The amortization entry of a month is dated the first day of that month of occupancy.

## Reading the ledger

| Month of occupancy | Amortization entry on the agreement's ledger | Agreement status | Booking under this rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| Began on or before the termination date | None | Terminated, refund scheduled or any later status | Booked once |
| Began on or before the termination date | Already present | Any | Not booked again |
| Began after the termination date | None | Any | Not booked |
| Any month | None | Occupied | Booked in the ordinary monthly course |

## Booking the entry

The entry is booked with the tool `book_final_period_amortization_cad149c9`, which the agent unlocks and then calls. It enters one amortization entry for a month of occupancy that has no amortization entry yet, carrying the month's sequence number and its first day as the posting date; the refundable balance of the agreement falls by the amount given and the agreement's status is left as it is. The tool computes nothing and checks no status of its own.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `entrance_agreement_id` | Reference number of the Entrance Fee Agreement amortized, read from the entrance fee agreement lookup | Identifier |
| `amortization_month` | Sequence number of the month of occupancy amortized | Integer, counted from 1 for the month beginning on the occupancy date |
| `month_start_date` | First day of that month of occupancy, entered as the posting date | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `amortization_amount` | The amount amortized | USD, non-negative, 2 decimal places, entered rounded half up to the cent |

**Receipt.** On success: `status` ("amortized"); `entrance_agreement_id`; `entrance_entry_id` (reference number of the amortization entry); `amortization_month` (integer); `posting_date` (YYYY-MM-DD); `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places); `refundable_balance` (the balance after the entry, USD, 2 decimal places).

## Hypothetical illustration

Occupancy on 10 January; the ledger carries entries for months 1 to 17, the last dated 10 May of the following year; the agreement terminated on 18 June. Month 18 began on 10 June, on or before the termination date, and has no entry: it is booked once, dated 10 June, with sequence number 18.
